body.x: SOLOSHOT(www.soloshot.com) showcased 'SOLOSHOT2' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

SOLOSHOT2 automatically keeps a camera pointed at users from up to 2,000 ft away. New features include real vertical tracking, a camera controller accessory dock for automatic zoom tracking and start/stop recording, a smaller lighter transmitter, compatibility with 3rd party professional tripods and the ability to network multiple SOLOSHOT2 transmitters and bases together into a robotic production crew.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.→linked to the special page on 'CES 2014'
